name: the bWo (Blue World order)
caption: Formed on-camera during the federation's debut broadcast when two feuding wrestlers shook hands mid-match; named Best Stable at the federation's own award show.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Sneak Peek broadcast, where the stable formed on camera, through its own award show, where it was named Best Stable.

name: Terrorize & Stryfe
caption: The HCW's own World Tag Team Champions, having beaten FIRE and the Party Animals for the vacant title; named Best Tag Team at the fed's own first Extremies awards show, 25 April 1997.

name: The Party Animals
caption: Named Most Improved Tag Team at the HCW's own first Extremies awards show, 25 April 1997; per the same broadcast's own rumour report, related to wrestler Jack Bradshaw.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (the-party-animals-cswa); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.
